search_text: published ZDI-20-287 ZDI-CAN-9656 (Pwn2Own) Xiaomi Mi9 Browser Untrusted Site Redirection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-03-12 CVE-2020-9531 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-9531 5.5 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ['Xiaomi'] ['Browser'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Xiaomi Mi9 Browser. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within Xiaomi GetApps webview. By manipulating HTML, an attacker can force a page redirection. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Fixed in v 2001122 ['2019-11-19 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2020-03-12 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] @FSecureLabs https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-20-287/
title: (Pwn2Own) Xiaomi Mi9 Browser Untrusted Site Redirection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Xiaomi Mi9 Browser. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within Xiaomi GetApps webview. By manipulating HTML, an attacker can force a page redirection. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
